# Contributing

Please check out common DSC Community [contributing guidelines](https://dsccommunity.org/guidelines/contributing).

## Running the Tests

Run the local build and test suite from the repository root:

```powershell
./build.ps1
```

See [BUILDING.md](../BUILDING.md) for build, test, and release guidance.

Use Conventional Commit messages for pull request titles. `feat:` requests a minor release; `fix:` and `perf:` request a patch; `!` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer requests a major release. `docs:`, `test:`, and `chore:` do not trigger releases.

For general guidance, see the DSC Community [contributing guidelines](https://dsccommunity.org/guidelines/contributing) and [testing guidelines](https://dsccommunity.org/guidelines/testing-guidelines/#running-tests).
